svg.aria-label: Plate III: verdigris eight-petal rosette stretched like furrow rounds around a perspective furrow field with seed dots, sweat-of-thy-face microtext ring
svg.title: Plate III · The first furrow
svg.desc: Privately issued banknote plate: an eight-petal verdigris lathe rosette stretched vertically like furrow rounds; a central field vignette of nine furrows running to a vanishing point with dotted seed-lines and seed dots; a microtext ring reading In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread; denomination cartouches III in the four corners.
